title: Fellowship of the Heart: a curriculum for formation in hearing and obeying God
description:
Fellowship of the Heart (FotH) is the group implementation of the Intentional Journey of the Heart framework: a practice-centred curriculum in which families and teenagers learn together to hear God, test what they hear, and obey. One core is adapted to each setting: an adult series run at whatever rhythm a group agrees on, a 22-session school-club design, and a biweekly evening series led by teenagers (in progress). This archive is a fixed snapshot of the published materials and their change logs; the live materials are at fellowshipoftheheart.org.

The CC BY-SA 4.0 license covers the curriculum only. It does not cover any participant content, which is not included in this repository.
